name: Daily Market Pipeline

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs Monday to Friday at 4:00 PM IST (10:30 UTC)
    - cron: '30 10 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to run it manually anytime from GitHub UI

jobs:
  run-pipeline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        cache: 'pip'

    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Market Pipeline
      env:
        TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN = "8621913930:AAFxwb_l7Fti6WOW_HfQjc0hyx7LKU9HY-I"
        TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID = "7605066005"

      run: |
        python main.py  # Replace main.py with your actual script filename
